d:
Official live performance video of "Endless Summer Stars" by Vidya Vox in San Francisco, Oct. 2016.
Hey guys! Shankar and I wrote this song over the summer. It means a lot to us because it represents my decision to do music full-time and making that jump was one of the scariest decisions I've had to make. It's been a beautiful journey so far, I hope I can keep pushing more boundaries for myself! We performed it publicly for the first time in the Bay Area, all the footage and recordings are live from that concert!
Thank you to my amazing musician friends who kick ass!
